item.description:
Use the DID Groups resource to retrieve DID inventory groups available in the DIDWW
coverage catalog.

A DID Group represents a group of DID phone numbers that share common coverage
characteristics, such as country, region, city, area, prefix, number type, features,
availability, pricing options, and registration requirements.

DID Groups are commonly used before creating an order. Use them to find available DID
phone number inventory, retrieve related Stock Keeping Unit data, check whether
registration is required, and select the correct `sku_id` for DID ordering.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all DID Groups | `GET` | `/v3/did_groups` |
| Retrieve DID Group | `GET` | `/v3/did_groups/{id}` |

## Retrieve all DID Groups

Retrieves all DID Groups available in the DIDWW coverage catalog.

Use this endpoint to search DID inventory by country, region, city, area, number type,
prefix, features, registration requirements, or availability.

See [Retrieve All DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/get-did-groups.html).

```
GET /v3/did_groups
```

## Retrieve DID Group

Retrieves a specific DID Group by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint when you already know the DID Group ID and need to retrieve its coverage
details, relationships, pricing options, or availability metadata.

See [Retrieve DID Group](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/get-did-group.html).

```
GET /v3/did_groups/{id}
```

## Common DID Group use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Search DID inventory | Find DID Groups available in a selected country, region, city, area, or prefix. |
| Check DID availability | Use availability metadata to determine whether DID phone numbers are currently available for purchase. |
| Filter by number type | Use the `number_type` filter to find local, national, mobile, toll-free, shared cost, or global DID inventory. |
| Select a SKU | Include Stock Keeping Units and use the selected Stock Keeping Unit `id` as `sku_id` when creating an order. |
| Check registration requirements | Check whether a DID Group requires address verification before activation. |
| Enable number selection | Use DID Groups that support available DID selection before retrieving specific available DID phone numbers. |
| Prepare an order | Use DID Group coverage, pricing, registration, and SKU data before creating a DID order. |

## Related resources

Use the DID Group ID and related resource IDs to continue DID inventory and ordering
flows.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Countries](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/countries/index.html) | Countries used to filter DID Groups. |
| [Regions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/regions/index.html) | Regions used to filter DID Groups where region-level coverage applies. |
| [Cities](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/city/index.html) | Cities used to filter DID Groups where city-level coverage applies. |
| [NANPA Prefixes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/nanpa/index.html) | NANPA prefixes used to filter North American DID inventory. |
| [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) | Specific DID phone numbers available for selection and reservation. |
| [DID Reservations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/index.html) | Reservations used before ordering a selected available DID phone number. |
| [Orders](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/index.html) | Orders created using the selected Stock Keeping Unit `id` as `sku_id`. |
| [Common Definitions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/common-definitions/index.html) | Shared embedded objects such as the Stock Keeping Unit Object. |

item.description:
Use the Available DIDs resource to retrieve DID phone numbers that are currently available
in the DIDWW inventory.

An Available DID represents a specific DID phone number that can be selected before
ordering. Available DIDs are used when a DID Group supports number selection and the
customer needs to choose a specific phone number instead of ordering from a DID Group
without selecting the number.

Available DIDs are commonly used before creating a DID Reservation or an order. Use them
to search available phone numbers, select a specific DID, reserve it when required, and
continue the DID ordering flow.

> **Note**
>
> Available DID requests are not enabled by default. To request access to this feature,
> contact DIDWW Customer Service or Sales.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all Available DIDs | `GET` | `/v3/available_dids` |
| Retrieve Available DID | `GET` | `/v3/available_dids/{id}` |

## Retrieve all Available DIDs

Retrieves all Available DIDs matching the request filters.

Use this endpoint to search specific DID phone numbers that are currently available for
selection and reservation.

See [Retrieve All Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/get-available-dids.html).

```
GET /v3/available_dids
```

## Retrieve Available DID

Retrieves a specific Available DID by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint when you already know the Available DID ID and need to retrieve details
for a selected phone number before reservation or ordering.

See [Retrieve Available DID](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/get-available-did.html).

```
GET /v3/available_dids/{id}
```

## Common Available DID use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Search selectable DID numbers | Retrieve specific DID phone numbers that are currently available in DIDWW inventory. |
| Select a phone number before ordering | Use Available DIDs when a customer needs to choose a specific DID phone number. |
| Prepare a DID reservation | Use the selected Available DID before creating a DID Reservation, when reservation is required. |
| Continue the ordering flow | Use the selected DID number together with DID Group and Stock Keeping Unit data before creating an order. |
| Check number-level availability | Confirm that a specific DID phone number is still available before reservation or ordering. |

## Related resources

Use Available DID IDs and related DID Group data to continue DID inventory and ordering
flows.

item.description:
Use the DID Reservations resource to create, retrieve, and cancel reservations for
[Available DID phone numbers](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html).

A DID Reservation temporarily holds an Available DID before ordering. This allows a
selected phone number to be reserved while the customer continues the DID ordering flow.

DID Reservations are commonly used after selecting a specific Available DID and before
creating an order. By default, a DID Reservation reserves up to 10 DID numbers for 10
minutes.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all DID Reservations | `GET` | `/v3/did_reservations` |
| Retrieve DID Reservation | `GET` | `/v3/did_reservations/{id}` |
| Create DID Reservation | `POST` | `/v3/did_reservations` |
| Delete DID Reservation | `DELETE` | `/v3/did_reservations/{id}` |

## Retrieve all DID Reservations

Retrieves all DID Reservations for the account.

Use this endpoint to list active DID Reservations and check reserved Available DIDs before
continuing the ordering flow.

The response can include related Available DID data, DID Group data, and Stock Keeping
Unit data.

See [Retrieve All DID Reservations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/get-did-reservations.html).

```
GET /v3/did_reservations
```

## Retrieve DID Reservation

Retrieves a specific DID Reservation by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint when you already know the DID Reservation ID and need to retrieve its
expiration time, creation time, description, and related Available DID before creating an
order.

The response can include the reserved Available DID, the related DID Group, and related
Stock Keeping Units.

See [Retrieve DID Reservation](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/get-did-reservation.html).

```
GET /v3/did_reservations/{id}
```

## Create DID Reservation

Creates a DID Reservation for a selected Available DID.

Use this endpoint after selecting an Available DID and before creating an order. The
request links the DID Reservation to an Available DID resource.

If the Available DID is not already reserved, the API creates a new DID Reservation. If
the Available DID is already reserved and an active reservation exists, the API may update
the current reservation.

See [Create DID Reservation](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/create-did-reservation.html).

```
POST /v3/did_reservations
```

## Delete DID Reservation

Deletes a DID Reservation by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint to cancel a reservation when the selected Available DID should no longer
be held before ordering.

See [Delete DID Reservation](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/delete-did-reservation.html).

```
DELETE /v3/did_reservations/{id}
```

## Common DID Reservation use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Reserve a selected DID number | Create a DID Reservation after selecting a specific Available DID phone number. |
| Hold a number before ordering | Temporarily hold an Available DID while preparing the order. |
| Check reservation expiration | Retrieve the reservation to check when the reserved number expires. |
| Continue the ordering flow | Use the reserved Available DID and related DID Group or Stock Keeping Unit data before creating an order. |
| Cancel a reservation | Delete a DID Reservation when the selected number should no longer be held. |
| Retrieve reserved number details | Include the related Available DID, DID Group, and Stock Keeping Units to review the selected number before ordering. |

## Related resources

Use DID Reservations together with Available DIDs and ordering resources to complete the
selected-number ordering flow.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) | Specific DID phone numbers available for selection and reservation. |
| [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) | DID inventory groups used to find coverage, features, pricing options, and number selection support. |
| [Orders](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/index.html) | Orders created after selecting or reserving an Available DID number. |
| [Countries](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/countries/index.html) | Countries used to filter DID inventory and coverage. |
| [Regions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/regions/index.html) | Regions used to filter DID inventory where region-level coverage applies. |
| [Cities](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/city/index.html) | Cities used to filter DID inventory where city-level coverage applies. |
| [NANPA Prefixes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/nanpa/index.html) | NANPA prefixes used for North American DID inventory. |
| [Common Definitions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/common-definitions/index.html) | Shared embedded objects such as the Stock Keeping Unit Object. |

item.description:
Use the NANPA Prefixes resource to retrieve NANPA prefixes available in the DIDWW
inventory.

A NANPA prefix identifies a numbering prefix within the North American Numbering Plan.
The `npa` attribute represents the Numbering Plan Area code, commonly referred to as
the area code. The `nxx` attribute represents the central office code within the NPA.

NANPA prefixes can be used to filter coverage and inventory resources by country, region,
NPA, NXX, combined NPA/NXX value, DID Group availability, or DID Group features.

> **Note**
>
> NANPA prefixes are available only for countries with country code `+1`.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all NANPA prefixes | `GET` | `/v3/nanpa_prefixes` |
| Retrieve a NANPA prefix | `GET` | `/v3/nanpa_prefixes/{id}` |

## Retrieve all NANPA prefixes

Retrieves all NANPA prefixes available in the DIDWW inventory.

See [Retrieve All NANPA Prefixes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/nanpa/get-nanpa-prefixes.html).

```
GET /v3/nanpa_prefixes
```

## Retrieve NANPA prefix

Retrieves a specific NANPA prefix by its unique ID.

See [Retrieve NANPA Prefix](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/nanpa/get-nanpa-prefix.html).

```
GET /v3/nanpa_prefixes/{id}
```

## Common NANPA prefix use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Filter North American DID inventory | Use NANPA prefixes to filter DID Groups and Available DIDs for countries with country code `+1`. |
| Search by area code | Use the `npa` value to find DID inventory for a specific Numbering Plan Area. |
| Search by central office code | Use the `nxx` value to narrow DID inventory within a specific NPA. |
| Filter by full NPA/NXX prefix | Use the combined NPA/NXX value to retrieve inventory for a specific numbering prefix. |
| Check DID availability | Filter NANPA prefixes by DID Group availability to find prefixes with available DIDs. |
| Filter by DID features | Filter NANPA prefixes by DID Group features such as inbound voice, outbound voice, T.38, inbound SMS, or outbound SMS. |

## Related resources

Use the NANPA prefix ID or its related country and region IDs to filter other Coverage
Resources.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Countries](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/countries/index.html) | Countries associated with NANPA prefixes. |
| [Regions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/regions/index.html) | Regions associated with NANPA prefixes. |
| [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) | DID inventory groups available for a NANPA prefix. |
| [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) | Available DIDs for a NANPA prefix. |

Use Coverage Resources to discover DIDWW inventory availability before creating an order.

These resources help you search available coverage by country, region, city, NANPA prefix,
number type, DID Group, and Available DID. You can also reserve selected DIDs temporarily
before completing an order.

## Resource overview

| Resource | Use it to |
| --- | --- |
| [Countries](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/countries/index.html) | Find countries where DIDWW inventory is available. |
| [Regions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/regions/index.html) | Filter coverage by state, province, or administrative region. |
| [Cities](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/city/index.html) | Search local coverage by city. |
| [NANPA Prefixes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/nanpa/index.html) | Filter coverage by area code and prefix in NANPA countries. |
| [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) | Find inventory groups matching a location, prefix, or number type. |
| [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) | Retrieve individual DIDs that are currently available for purchase. |
| [DID Reservations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/index.html) | Temporarily reserve selected DIDs before completing an order. |

## Common workflows

A typical coverage search starts with a broad location lookup and narrows down to specific
inventory.

```
Country
 ├─ Region
 │  └─ City
 ├─ NANPA Prefix
 └─ DID Group (filtered by number type)
    └─ Available DID
       └─ DID Reservation
```

> **Note**
>
> Not every country uses every coverage level. NANPA prefixes apply to NANPA countries,
> while the available regions and cities depend on each country's inventory structure.

### Find available inventory

1. Retrieve [Countries](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/countries/index.html) where DIDWW inventory is available.
2. Narrow the location with [Regions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/regions/index.html), [Cities](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/city/index.html), or
   [NANPA Prefixes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/nanpa/index.html) where applicable.
3. Search [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) that match the required location, prefix,
   and number type. Use the `number_type` filter to select local, national, mobile,
   toll-free, shared cost, or global numbers.
4. Optionally retrieve [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) from the selected DID
   Group to choose individual numbers.

> **Note**
>
> Available DID requests are not enabled by default. To request access to this feature,
> contact DIDWW Customer Service or Sales.

### Reserve selected DIDs

Use [DID Reservations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/index.html) when your checkout or provisioning
flow requires time between selecting numbers and creating an order.

## Related resources

After identifying or reserving DIDs, use Inventory Resources to create orders and manage
purchased numbers.

- [Orders](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/index.html) - Create an order for the selected
  inventory.
- [DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/index.html) - Retrieve and configure purchased DIDs.

item.description:
Use the Balance resource to retrieve the prepaid balance and available credit for your
DIDWW account.

A Balance record provides the prepaid account balance, the available credit, and the total
balance. The total balance is the sum of the prepaid balance and available credit.

Use this resource to check the funds available on the account before creating orders or
performing other inventory operations that may incur charges.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve account balance | `GET` | `/v3/balance` |

## Retrieve account balance

Retrieves the prepaid balance, available credit, and total balance for the account.

Use this endpoint to determine the total funds available before continuing an inventory or
ordering workflow.

See [Retrieve Account Balance](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/balance/get-balance.html).

```
GET /v3/balance
```

## Common balance use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Check the prepaid balance | Retrieve the prepaid funds currently available on the account. |
| View available credit | Retrieve the credit currently available to the account. |
| Determine the total balance | Use `total_balance` to view the combined prepaid balance and available credit. |
| Prepare an ordering workflow | Check the total funds available before creating a DID order. |
| Monitor account funds | Retrieve the balance periodically as part of account and inventory management. |

## Related resources

Use the account balance together with inventory and coverage resources when preparing DID
orders.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Orders](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/index.html) | Orders that may use the funds available on the account. |
| [DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/index.html) | Purchased DID phone numbers associated with the account. |
| [Coverage Resources](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/index.html) | Resources used to find DID inventory before creating an order. |
| [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) | DID inventory groups with related pricing and Stock Keeping Unit data. |
| [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) | Specific DID phone numbers available for selection before ordering. |

item.description:
Use the Orders resource to create, retrieve, update, and cancel orders associated with your
DIDWW account.

An Order records a purchase and provides its reference, amount, status, description,
creation time, and ordered items. Order items can describe DID phone numbers, channels
added to a Capacity Pool, Emergency Calling charges, or other charges, for example a
[Sender ID verification](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/sender-id-verifications/index.html).

Orders are commonly used after checking the account balance and selecting DID inventory.
Use a Stock Keeping Unit `id` as `sku_id` to order DID phone numbers in bulk, purchase
a specific Available DID, or complete the purchase of a reserved DID. Orders can also be
used to add channels to a Capacity Pool.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all Orders | `GET` | `/v3/orders` |
| Retrieve Order | `GET` | `/v3/orders/{id}` |
| Create Order | `POST` | `/v3/orders` |
| Update Order | `PATCH` | `/v3/orders/{id}` |
| Cancel Order | `DELETE` | `/v3/orders/{id}` |

## Retrieve all Orders

Retrieves all Orders associated with the account.

Use this endpoint to review order history and filter Orders by ID, status, creation date,
reference, or external reference ID. Results can be sorted by status, amount, creation
time, reference, or external reference ID.

See [Retrieve All Orders](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/get-orders.html).

```
GET /v3/orders
```

## Retrieve Order

Retrieves a specific Order by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint to check the Order status, amount, reference, ordered items, billing
details, and callback configuration.

See [Retrieve Order](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/get-order.html).

```
GET /v3/orders/{id}
```

## Create Order

Creates an Order for DID phone numbers or additional channels.

For DID orders, provide a Stock Keeping Unit `id` as `sku_id` together with a quantity,
an Available DID ID, or a DID Reservation ID. The request can also control back-ordering,
provide an external reference ID, and configure order event callbacks.

For channel orders, provide the Capacity Pool ID and the required quantity.

See [Create Order](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/create-order.html).

```
POST /v3/orders
```

## Update Order

Updates the `external_reference_id` of an Order. No other attribute of an Order can be
changed.

See [Update Order](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/update-order.html).

```
PATCH /v3/orders/{id}
```

## Cancel Order

Cancels an Order that is still in `pending` status.

Use this endpoint when a pending Order should not be completed. Canceling the Order also
removes the DID phone numbers included in that Order.

See [Cancel Order](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/cancel-order.html).

```
DELETE /v3/orders/{id}
```

## Common Order use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Review account orders | Retrieve the account's Order history and inspect amounts, references, and ordered items. |
| Track Order status | Determine whether an Order is `pending`, `completed`, or `canceled`. |
| Order DID numbers in bulk | Use a Stock Keeping Unit `id` as `sku_id` together with `qty` to order multiple DID phone numbers. |
| Order a specific DID number | Use `available_did_id` with `sku_id` to purchase a selected Available DID. |
| Complete a reserved DID purchase | Use `did_reservation_id` with `sku_id` to purchase a reserved DID phone number. |
| Increase channel capacity | Use a Capacity Pool ID and quantity to add channels to the pool. |
| Receive Order events | Configure a callback URL and method to receive events related to the Order. |
| Cancel a pending Order | Cancel an Order before it is completed and remove its included DID phone numbers. |

## Related resources

Use Orders together with balance, coverage, and inventory resources to purchase DIDs and
add channels to a Capacity Pool.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Balance](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/balance/index.html) | Account funds available before creating an Order. |
| [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) | DID inventory groups that provide Stock Keeping Units for ordering. |
| [Available DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/available-did/index.html) | Specific DID phone numbers that can be selected before ordering. |
| [DID Reservations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-reservation/index.html) | Temporary reservations used to hold selected DID phone numbers before ordering. |
| [DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/index.html) | Purchased DID phone numbers created through completed DID Orders. |
| [Capacity Pools](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/capacity-pool/index.html) | Capacity pools to which purchased channels are assigned. |
| [Common Definitions](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/common-definitions/index.html) | Shared embedded objects such as the Stock Keeping Unit Object. |

request.description:
Update the settings of a single DID owned by your account. Using this endpoint you can cancel, restore or renew DID.

To cancel a DID, attribute `terminated` must be `true`, to renew or restore DID attribute `terminated` must be `false`.

## Request

HTTP Method: `PATCH`

URI Path: `/v3/dids/{id}`

### URI Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | Yes | Unique ID number allocated to this DID |

## Attributes

| Name | Type | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| terminated | `boolean` | Optional | If set to `true`, it will cancel a DID number. To renew or restore a DID number, the attribute must be set to `false`. |
| description | `string` | Optional | A DID number description. |
| billing\_cycles\_count | `integer` | Optional | The number of Billing Cycles that this DID Number will renew until expiration. If set to `0`, then DID will not be renewed. If set to `null`, then DID will be renewed infinitely. After each renew value will be decreased by 1 if it is set. Maximum value of `billing_cycles_count` is 999. |
| dedicated\_channels\_count | `integer` | Optional | Amount of dedicated channels to assign. |
| capacity\_limit | `integer` | Optional | Limits incoming capacity per DID number according to entered value. If set as `null`, assigned capacity is not limited. |

## Inbound SMS Routing

A DID routes inbound SMS to one SMS trunk or to one SMS trunk group, never both. Set the
route with the `sms_trunk` relationship (see [SMS Trunks](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/sms-trunks/index.html)) or
the `sms_trunk_group` relationship (see [SMS Trunk Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/sms-trunk-groups/index.html)).

- Assigning one of the two relationships replaces the route set through the other one.
- Sending both `sms_trunk` and `sms_trunk_group` with an ID in the same request returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
  Sending one of them with an ID and the other with `"data": null` assigns the ID.
- The SMS trunk must accept inbound SMS. A trunk with the `http_out` configuration type is rejected with `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
- The DID Group of the DID must support inbound SMS (its `features` include `sms_in`). Otherwise the request returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
- An SMS trunk or SMS trunk group that does not exist or does not belong to your account returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
- Sending `"data": null` clears the route only when the DID is currently routed through that relationship. For example, `sms_trunk_group` with `"data": null` does not change a DID routed to a single SMS trunk.

## Other Responses

| Code | Success | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 404 | No | [Not Found](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-not-found) |
| 400 | No | [Bad Request](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-bad-request) |
| 401 | No | [Unauthorized](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-v35) |
| 403 | No | The access token carries the `read` scope, which does not cover this method (title `Insufficient scope`). The response carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"`. See [Scopes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-scopes-v35). |
| 422 | No | [Unprocessable Entity](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-validation-error-object) |
| 429 | No | The request budget of the account for the current window is spent (`too_many_requests`). `Retry-After` gives the number of seconds to wait. |

item.description:
Use the DIDs resource to retrieve and manage DID phone numbers owned by your DIDWW
account.

A DID represents a purchased phone number and provides its service status, description,
renewal settings, capacity configuration, and expiration information. It also links to
related order, coverage, inbound voice and SMS routing, capacity, registration, identity,
and Emergency Calling resources.

DIDs are commonly managed after an Order is completed. Use this resource to find owned
phone numbers, inspect their configuration and relationships, update renewal or capacity
settings, and cancel, restore, or renew a DID.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all DIDs | `GET` | `/v3/dids` |
| Retrieve DID | `GET` | `/v3/dids/{id}` |
| Update DID | `PATCH` | `/v3/dids/{id}` |

## Retrieve all DIDs

Retrieves all DID phone numbers owned by the account.

Use this endpoint to filter DIDs by phone number, description, lifecycle status, renewal
settings, coverage, Order, inbound routing, capacity, registration, or Emergency Calling
configuration. Related resources can be included in the response.

See [Retrieve All DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/get-dids.html).

```
GET /v3/dids
```

## Retrieve DID

Retrieves a specific DID by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint to inspect the DID's status, phone number, description, expiration and
renewal settings, capacity configuration, and related resources.

See [Retrieve DID](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/get-did.html).

```
GET /v3/dids/{id}
```

## Update DID

Updates the settings of a specific DID.

Use this endpoint to update the DID description, renewal cycles, dedicated channel count,
or incoming capacity limit, and to route inbound calls and inbound SMS. Set `terminated`
to `true` to cancel the DID at the end of the billing cycle, or set it to `false` to
renew or restore the DID.

See [Update DID](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/update-did.html).

```
PATCH /v3/dids/{id}
```

## Common DID use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| List owned DID numbers | Retrieve the DID phone numbers currently associated with the account. |
| Search and filter DIDs | Find DIDs by number, description, lifecycle status, coverage, Order, routing, or capacity relationships. |
| Inspect DID status | Check whether a DID is blocked, awaiting registration, pending removal, or terminated. |
| Update the DID description | Add or change the customer-defined description used to identify a DID. |
| Manage DID renewal | Set `billing_cycles_count` to control automatic renewal or expiration. |
| Cancel or restore a DID | Update `terminated` to cancel a DID or renew and restore its service. |
| Configure DID capacity | Assign dedicated channels or set the maximum incoming capacity for a DID. |
| Route inbound SMS | Assign an SMS trunk or an SMS trunk group that receives inbound SMS for the DID. |
| Inspect related services | Include routing, capacity, registration, identity, coverage, Order, or Emergency Calling resources in the response. |

item.description:
Use the DID History resource to retrieve recent history records for DID phone numbers
associated with your DIDWW account.

A DID History record represents a lifecycle event for a DID phone number. Each record
identifies the DID number, the action performed, the method through which it was performed,
and the event creation time.

Use DID History to review DID assignment, renewal, cancellation, removal, restoration, and
billing cycle count changes. Records for billing cycle count changes also provide the
previous and new values.

> **Note**
>
> Only DID History records from the last `90` days are available.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all DID History records | `GET` | `/v3/did_history` |
| Retrieve DID History record | `GET` | `/v3/did_history/{id}` |

## Retrieve all DID History records

Retrieves all DID History records available for the account from the last 90 days.

Use this endpoint to filter records by ID, DID number, action, method, or creation time.
Results can be sorted by creation time and are paginated.

See [Retrieve All DID History Records](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did-history/get-did-histories.html).

```
GET /v3/did_history
```

## Retrieve DID History record

Retrieves a specific DID History record by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint when you already know the history record ID and need to inspect its DID
number, action, source method, timestamp, or billing cycle count change details.

See [Retrieve DID History Record](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did-history/get-did-history.html).

```
GET /v3/did_history/{id}
```

## Common DID History use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Review DID lifecycle events | Find recent assignment, renewal, cancellation, removal, and restoration events. |
| Track renewal-setting changes | Review `billing_cycles_count_changed` records and compare their `meta.from` and `meta.to` values. |
| Audit the action source | Determine whether an action was performed by the system, API v2, API v3, staff, or the user panel. |
| Review a specific DID number | Filter recent history records by DID phone number. |
| Search within a timeframe | Filter records by their creation time within the available 90-day period. |
| Investigate recent DID changes | Use history records to understand when and how a DID's lifecycle or renewal setting changed. |

## Related resources

Use DID History together with active DID, Order, and coverage data when reviewing recent
phone number changes.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/index.html) | DID phone numbers currently owned and managed by the account. |
| [Orders](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/order/index.html) | Orders through which DID phone numbers are purchased. |
| [DID Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/did-group/index.html) | Coverage and inventory groups associated with DID phone numbers. |

request.description:
You can create several type of inbound trunks: SIP, PSTN.

## Request

HTTP Method: `POST`

URI Path: `/v3/voice_in_trunks`

### Body Parameters

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | `string` | No | Yes | Trunks |
| attributes | `object` | No | Yes | Trunk configuration complex object. |

### Data Attributes

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| priority | `integer` | No | No | The priority of this target host. DIDWW will attempt to contact the target trunk with the lowest-numbered priority; target trunk with the same priority will be tried in an order defined by the weight field. The range is 0-65535. See [RFC 2782](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2782) for more details. |
| weight | `integer` | No | No | A trunk selection mechanism. The weight field specifies a relative weight for entries with the same priority. Larger weights will be given a proportionately higher probability of being selected. The range of this number is 0-65535. In the presence of records containing weights greater than 0, records with weight 0 will have a very small chance of being selected. See [RFC 2782](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2782) for more details. |
| capacity\_limit | `integer` | Yes | No | Maximum number of simultaneous calls for the trunk. |
| ringing\_timeout | `integer` | Yes | No | Ring time in seconds. Supported values are integers from 1 to 32. Null uses the platform default. If the call is not connected within this time, the transaction is ended with the disconnect code **Ringing timeout**. |
| name | `string` | No | Yes | Friendly name of the trunk. Unique among the trunks and trunk groups of the account - they share one name space. |
| external\_reference\_id | `string` | Yes | No | Optional identifier for the inbound trunk in the customer's external system. Maximum length is 100 characters. |
| cli\_format | `string` | Yes | No | **raw** - Do not alter CLI. **e164** - Attempt to convert CLI to E.164 format (default). **local** - Attempt to convert CLI to Localized format. **CLI format conversion may not work correctly for phone calls originating from outside the country of that specific DID**. |
| cli\_prefix | `string` | Yes | No | You may prefix the CLI with an optional `+` sign followed by up to 6 characters, including digits and `#`. |
| description | `string` | Yes | No | Optional description of the trunk. |
| pop | `string` | Yes | No | Point of Presence the trunk is pinned to. Possible values: `nyc`, `fra`, `lac`, `mia`, `sg`, `hk`, `ams`. `null` lets DIDWW choose. Any other value returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`. |
| configuration | One of [sip\_configurations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35), [pstn\_configurations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35) | No | Yes | Trunk configuration complex object. |

### Object Relationships

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| voice\_in\_trunk\_group | [Trunk Group Object](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/trunk-group-object.html#voice-in-trunk-group-object-v35) |

### Attributes Configuration

**SIP**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | `sip_configurations` | No | Yes | SIP configuration complex object. |
| attributes | [sip\_configuration\_attributes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35) | No | Yes | SIP configuration attributes object. |

**PSTN**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | `pstn_configurations` | No | Yes | PSTN configuration complex object. |
| attributes | [pstn\_configuration\_attributes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35) | No | Yes | PSTN configuration attributes object. |

### Configuration Attributes

**SIP**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| username | `string` | Yes | No | User part of R-URI in INVITE request. You also may use "{DID}" pattern which will be replaced by called DID number in E164 format. For example, you can set Username to "+{DID}"; if you wish to have it in +E164 format |
| host | `string` | Yes | No | Host part of R-URI in INVITE request. Required while `enabled_sip_registration` is `false`, and rejected while it is `true`. |
| port | `integer` | Yes | No | Port part of R-URI in INVITE request (is not mandatory). If port is null, SRV record will be resolved (or A record if SRV is unavailable). Must be empty while `enabled_sip_registration` is `true`. |
| codecs | Array of `strings` | No | No | Codecs offered on calls to the trunk, in priority order: the first has the highest priority. Send at least one value, without repeats. Possible values: `telephone_event`, `g723`, `g729`, `pcmu`, `pcma`, `speex`, `gsm`, `g726_32`, `g721`, `g726_24`, `g726_40`, `g726_16`, `l16`, `amr`, `amr_wb`. Defaults to `pcmu`, `pcma`, `g729`, `g723`, `telephone_event`. See [Codecs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/codecs.html#trunk-codecs-v35). |
| rx\_dtmf\_format\_id | `integer` | No | No | The method id for receiving DTMF signals from customers equipment. Possible values: `1` - RFC 2833; `2` - SIP INFO `application/dtmf-relay` or `application/dtmf`; `3` - RFC 2833 or SIP INFO. |
| tx\_dtmf\_format\_id | `integer` | No | No | The method of sending DTMF signals to the customer's equipment. Possible values: `0` - Disable sending; `1` - RFC 2833; `2` - SIP INFO `application/dtmf-relay`; `4` - SIP INFO `application/dtmf`. |
| resolve\_ruri | `boolean` | No | No | Replace host part of the R-URI by resolved IP address. |
| auth\_enabled | `boolean` | No | No | Enable authorization for the SIP server. |
| auth\_user | `string` | Yes | No | Authorization user for the SIP server. Required while `auth_enabled` is `true`, and rejected while it is `false`. |
| auth\_password | `string` | Yes | No | Authorization password for the SIP server. Required while `auth_enabled` is `true`, and rejected while it is `false`. |
| auth\_from\_user | `string` | Yes | No | Specify user in a **from** field instead of CallerID (overrides CallerID). Some equipment require **from**; to be equivalent to **Auth user**. |
| auth\_from\_domain | `string` | Yes | No | Sets default **from** domain in SIP messages. Some equipment may require specific **From** Domain. |
| sst\_enabled | `boolean` | No | No | Enable SIP Session timers customization. SIP session timers are used to make sure that a session (dialog) is still alive, even though there may have been a long time since the last in-dialog message. If the other end is not responding, the dialog will be hung up automatically. SIP session timers need to be supported by all end points for it to work. It's a SIP extension, standardized by the IETF. See [RFC 4028](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4028) for more details. |
| sst\_min\_timer | `integer` | Yes | No | Minimal SIP Session timer value (Default 600 seconds). See [RFC 4028](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4028) for more details. |
| sst\_max\_timer | `integer` | Yes | No | Maximal SIP Session timer value (Default 900 seconds). See [RFC 4028](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4028) for more details. |
| sst\_accept\_501 | `boolean` | No | No | Do not drop the call after receiving SIP 501 response for non-critical messages. |
| sip\_timer\_b | `integer` | No | No | INVITE transaction timeout (Default 8000ms). See [RFC 3261 Section 17.1.1.2](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3261#section-17.1.1.2) for more details. |
| dns\_srv\_failover\_timer | `integer` | Yes | No | Invite transaction timeout for each of gateways with DNS SRV rerouting (Default 2000ms). |
| rtp\_ping | `boolean` | Yes | No | Use RTP PING when connecting a call. After establishing the call, DIDWW will send empty RTP packet **RTP PING**. It is necessary if both parties operate in Symmetric RTP / Comedia mode and expect the other party to start sending RTP first. |
| rtp\_timeout | `integer` | No | No | Disconnect the call if the RTP packets do not arrive within the specified time. |
| force\_symmetric\_rtp | `boolean` | Yes | No | Forced to work in Symmetric RTP / COMEDIA mode. |
| symmetric\_rtp\_ignore\_rtcp | `boolean` | Yes | No | Avoid switching RTP session based on RTCP packet while working in Symmetric RTP / COMEDIA. Only RTP packets will be considered. |
| rerouting\_disconnect\_code\_ids | `array` | Yes | No | [Rerouting disconnect codes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/rerouting-disconnect-codes.html#disconnect-codes-v35). |
| sst\_session\_expires | `integer` | Yes | No | Session-Expires header value. Optional, should be in range with **sst\_min\_timer** and **sst\_max\_timer**. See [RFC 4028](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4028) for more details. |
| sst\_refresh\_method\_id | `integer` | No | No | SIP method which will be used for session update. See [RFC 4028](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4028) for more details. Possible values: `1` - Invite; `2` - Update; `3` - Update fallback Invite. |
| transport\_protocol\_id | `integer` | No | No | The transport layer that will be responsible for the actual transmission of SIP requests and responses: `1` - UDP; `2` - TCP; `3` - TLS. |
| max\_transfers | `integer` | No | No | Max count of the **REFER** requests. |
| max\_30x\_redirects | `integer` | No | No | Max count of 301/302 redirects. |
| media\_encryption\_mode | `string` | No | No | Media encryption mode. See [RFC4568 about SRTP SDES](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4568), [RFC5764 about SRTP DTLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5764), and [RFC6189 about ZRTP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6189) for more details. Possible values: `disabled` - Disabled; `srtp_sdes` - SRTP SDES; `srtp_dtls` - SRTP DTLS; `zrtp` - ZRTP. |
| ice\_mode | `string` | No | No | ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) for calls to the trunk: not used, accepted when the trunk offers it, or initiated by DIDWW. Possible values: `disabled`, `accept`, `initiate`. Defaults to `disabled`. |
| rtcp\_mux\_mode | `string` | No | No | RTP and RTCP multiplexed on one port: not used, accepted when the trunk offers it, or initiated by DIDWW. Possible values: `disabled`, `accept`, `initiate`. Defaults to `disabled`. |
| rtcp\_feedback\_mode | `string` | No | No | RTCP feedback (AVPF): not used, accepted when the trunk offers it, or initiated by DIDWW. Possible values: `disabled`, `accept`, `initiate`. Defaults to `disabled`. |
| stir\_shaken\_mode | `string` | No | No | Stir/Shaken mode. See [STIR/SHAKEN](https://doc.didww.com/voice/inbound-trunks/sip-trunks/call-information/stir-shaken-headers.html#service-did-stir-shaken) for more details. Possible values: `disabled` - Do not send identity; `original` - Transit Identity header as is; `pai` - Add PAI, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID; `original_pai` - Transit Identity header as is and add PAI, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID; `verstat` - Add P-Stir-Verstat, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID. |
| allowed\_rtp\_ips | Array of `strings` | Yes | No | The allowed RTP IPs: IPv4 or IPv6, single or subnet. Up to 10 items. Null means no restriction. An empty list is rejected. `0.0.0.0/0` and `::/0` are rejected. |
| network\_protocol\_priority | `string` | No | No | Network protocol priority for SIP routing. Possible values: `force_ipv4` - Use IPv4 exclusively. `force_ipv6` - Use IPv6 exclusively. `any` - Use either IPv4 or IPv6. `prefer_ipv4` - Prefer IPv4 but fall back to IPv6. `prefer_ipv6` - Prefer IPv6 but fall back to IPv4. |
| enabled\_sip\_registration | `boolean` | No | No | Enables SIP registration for the trunk. Enabling it generates `incoming_auth_username` and `incoming_auth_password`. |
| use\_did\_in\_ruri | `boolean` | No | No | Uses the called DID in the R-URI. Requires `enabled_sip_registration` to be `true`: sending `true` while it is `false` returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`. |
| diversion\_relay\_policy | `string` | No | No | Controls how Diversion information is relayed. Possible values: `none` - Do not relay the Diversion header. `as_is` - Relay the Diversion header as received. `sip` - Relay the Diversion header as a SIP URI. `tel` - Relay the Diversion header as a TEL URI. |
| diversion\_inject\_mode | `string` | No | No | Controls how Diversion information is injected. Possible values: `none` - Do not add a Diversion header. `did_number` - Add a Diversion header using the DID number in E.164 format. |
| cnam\_lookup | `boolean` | No | No | Enables inbound CNAM lookup. |

**PSTN**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dst | `string` | No | Yes | Number calls are forwarded to, in E.164 without the leading `+`. Digits only, up to 15 digits. |

## Other Responses

| Code | Success | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 422 | No | [Unprocessable Entity](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-validation-error-object) |
| 400 | No | [Bad Request](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-bad-request). The body is malformed: `configuration` is missing, or it carries a member the API does not accept. Also returned with the title `Quota limit reached` when the account has reached its limit of inbound trunks. |
| 401 | No | [Unauthorized](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-v35) |
| 403 | No | The access token carries the `read` scope, which does not cover this method (title `Insufficient scope`). The response carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"`. See [Scopes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-scopes-v35). |
| 429 | No | The request budget of the account for the current window is spent (`too_many_requests`). `Retry-After` gives the number of seconds to wait. |

| max\_transfers | `integer` | No | No | Max count of the **REFER** requests. |
| max\_30x\_redirects | `integer` | No | No | Max count of 301/302 redirects. |
| media\_encryption\_mode | `string` | No | No | Media encryption mode. See [RFC4568 about SRTP SDES](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4568), [RFC5764 about SRTP DTLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5764), and [RFC6189 about ZRTP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6189) for more details. Possible values: `disabled` - Disabled; `srtp_sdes` - SRTP SDES; `srtp_dtls` - SRTP DTLS; `zrtp` - ZRTP. |
| ice\_mode | `string` | No | No | ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) for calls to the trunk: not used, accepted when the trunk offers it, or initiated by DIDWW. Possible values: `disabled`, `accept`, `initiate`. |
| rtcp\_mux\_mode | `string` | No | No | RTP and RTCP multiplexed on one port: not used, accepted when the trunk offers it, or initiated by DIDWW. Possible values: `disabled`, `accept`, `initiate`. |
| rtcp\_feedback\_mode | `string` | No | No | RTCP feedback (AVPF): not used, accepted when the trunk offers it, or initiated by DIDWW. Possible values: `disabled`, `accept`, `initiate`. |
| stir\_shaken\_mode | `string` | No | No | Stir/Shaken mode. See [STIR/SHAKEN](https://doc.didww.com/voice/inbound-trunks/sip-trunks/call-information/stir-shaken-headers.html#service-did-stir-shaken) for more details. Possible values: `disabled` - Do not send identity; `original` - Transit Identity header as is; `pai` - Add PAI, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID; `original_pai` - Transit Identity header as is and add PAI, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID; `verstat` - Add P-Stir-Verstat, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID. |
| allowed\_rtp\_ips | Array of `strings` | Yes | No | The allowed RTP IPs: IPv4 or IPv6, single or subnet. Up to 10 items. Null means no restriction. An empty list is rejected. `0.0.0.0/0` and `::/0` are rejected. |
| network\_protocol\_priority | `string` | No | No | Network protocol priority for SIP routing. Possible values: `force_ipv4` - Use IPv4 exclusively. `force_ipv6` - Use IPv6 exclusively. `any` - Use either IPv4 or IPv6. `prefer_ipv4` - Prefer IPv4 but fall back to IPv6. `prefer_ipv6` - Prefer IPv6 but fall back to IPv4. |
| enabled\_sip\_registration | `boolean` | No | No | Enables SIP registration for the trunk. Enabling it generates `incoming_auth_username` and `incoming_auth_password`. |
| use\_did\_in\_ruri | `boolean` | No | No | Uses the called DID in the R-URI. Requires `enabled_sip_registration` to be `true`: a request that leaves this attribute `true` while `enabled_sip_registration` is `false` returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`. |
| diversion\_relay\_policy | `string` | No | No | Controls how Diversion information is relayed. Possible values: `none` - Do not relay the Diversion header. `as_is` - Relay the Diversion header as received. `sip` - Relay the Diversion header as a SIP URI. `tel` - Relay the Diversion header as a TEL URI. |
| diversion\_inject\_mode | `string` | No | No | Controls how Diversion information is injected. Possible values: `none` - Do not add a Diversion header. `did_number` - Add a Diversion header using the DID number in E.164 format. |
| cnam\_lookup | `boolean` | No | No | Enables inbound CNAM lookup. |

**PSTN**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dst | `string` | No | Yes | Number calls are forwarded to, in E.164 without the leading `+`. Digits only, up to 15 digits. |

## Other Responses

| Code | Success | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 404 | No | [Not Found](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-not-found) |
| 422 | No | [Unprocessable Entity](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-validation-error-object) |
| 400 | No | [Bad Request](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-bad-request). The body carries a member the API does not accept. |
| 401 | No | [Unauthorized](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-v35) |
| 403 | No | The access token carries the `read` scope, which does not cover this method (title `Insufficient scope`). The response carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"`. See [Scopes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-scopes-v35). |
| 429 | No | The request budget of the account for the current window is spent (`too_many_requests`). `Retry-After` gives the number of seconds to wait. |

variable.description: `string` Required. Unique ID identifier of Trunk.

request.description:
Updates an inbound trunk.

## Request

HTTP Method: `PATCH`

URI Path: `/v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}`

### URI Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | Yes | Unique ID identifier of Trunk. |

### Data Attributes

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| priority | `integer` | No | No | The priority of this target host. DIDWW will attempt to contact the target trunk with the lowest-numbered priority; target trunk with the same priority will be tried in an order defined by the weight field. The range is 0-65535. See [RFC 2782](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2782) for more details. |
| weight | `integer` | No | No | A trunk selection mechanism. The weight field specifies a relative weight for entries with the same priority. Larger weights will be given a proportionately higher probability of being selected. The range of this number is 0-65535. In the presence of records containing weights greater than 0, records with weight 0 will have a very small chance of being selected. See [RFC 2782](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2782) for more details. |
| capacity\_limit | `integer` | Yes | No | Maximum number of simultaneous calls for the trunk. |
| ringing\_timeout | `integer` | Yes | No | Ring time in seconds. Supported values are integers from 1 to 32. Null uses the platform default. If the call is not connected within this time, the transaction is ended with the disconnect code **Ringing timeout**. |
| name | `string` | No | No | Friendly name of the trunk. Unique among the trunks and trunk groups of the account - they share one name space. |
| external\_reference\_id | `string` | Yes | No | Optional identifier for the inbound trunk in the customer's external system. Maximum length is 100 characters. |
| cli\_format | `string` | Yes | No | **raw** - Do not alter CLI. **e164** - Attempt to convert CLI to E.164 format (default). **local** - Attempt to convert CLI to Localized format. **CLI format conversion may not work correctly for phone calls originating from outside the country of that specific DID**. |
| cli\_prefix | `string` | Yes | No | You may prefix the CLI with an optional `+` sign followed by up to 6 characters, including digits and `#`. |
| description | `string` | Yes | No | Optional description of the trunk. |
| pop | `string` | Yes | No | Point of Presence the trunk is pinned to. Possible values: `nyc`, `fra`, `lac`, `mia`, `sg`, `hk`, `ams`. `null` lets DIDWW choose. Any other value returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`. |
| configuration | One of [sip\_configurations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35), [pstn\_configurations](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35) | No | No | Trunk configuration complex object. `type` must match the trunk's; the members you send are written and the rest keep their stored values. |

### Object Relationships

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| voice\_in\_trunk\_group | [Trunk Group Object](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/trunk-group-object.html#voice-in-trunk-group-object-v35) |

### Attributes Configuration

**SIP**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | `sip_configurations` | No | Yes | SIP configuration complex object. |
| attributes | [sip\_configuration\_attributes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35) | No | Yes | SIP configuration attributes object. |

**PSTN**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | `pstn_configurations` | No | Yes | PSTN configuration complex object. |
| attributes | [pstn\_configuration\_attributes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html#trunk-attributes-v35) | No | Yes | PSTN configuration attributes object. |

### Configuration Attributes

**SIP**

| Name | Type | Nullable | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| username | `string` | Yes | No | User part of R-URI in INVITE request. You also may use "{DID}" pattern which will be replaced by called DID number in E164 format. For example, you can set Username to "+{DID}"; if you wish to have it in +E164 format |
| host | `string` | Yes | No | Host part of R-URI in INVITE request. Required while `enabled_sip_registration` is `false`, and rejected while it is `true`. |
| port | `integer` | Yes | No | Port part of R-URI in INVITE request (is not mandatory). If port is null, SRV record will be resolved (or A record if SRV is unavailable). Must be empty while `enabled_sip_registration` is `true`. |
| codecs | Array of `strings` | No | No | Codecs offered on calls to the trunk, in priority order: the first has the highest priority. Send at least one value, without repeats. Possible values: `telephone_event`, `g723`, `g729`, `pcmu`, `pcma`, `speex`, `gsm`, `g726_32`, `g721`, `g726_24`, `g726_40`, `g726_16`, `l16`, `amr`, `amr_wb`. See [Codecs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/codecs.html#trunk-codecs-v35). |
| rx\_dtmf\_format\_id | `integer` | No | No | The method id for receiving DTMF signals from customers equipment. Possible values: `1` - RFC 2833; `2` - SIP INFO `application/dtmf-relay` or `application/dtmf`; `3` - RFC 2833 or SIP INFO. |
| tx\_dtmf\_format\_id | `integer` | No | No | The method of sending DTMF signals to the customer's equipment. Possible values: `0` - Disable sending; `1` - RFC 2833; `2` - SIP INFO `application/dtmf-relay`; `4` - SIP INFO `application/dtmf`. |
| resolve\_ruri | `boolean` | No | No | Replace host part of the R-URI by resolved IP address. |

item.description:
Use the Inbound Trunks resource to create, retrieve, update, and delete routing destinations
for incoming calls to your DID phone numbers.

An Inbound Trunk represents a SIP or PSTN destination to which DIDWW can route incoming
calls. Each trunk defines its destination configuration and can also specify routing
priority, weight, simultaneous-call limit, ringing timeout, calling-line-identification
format, and other call-delivery settings.

Inbound Trunks can be assigned directly to DIDs or organized into Inbound Trunk Groups for
routing and failover. A trunk can also be pinned to a DIDWW Point of Presence (POP) through
its `pop` attribute.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all Inbound Trunks | `GET` | `/v3/voice_in_trunks` |
| Retrieve Inbound Trunk | `GET` | `/v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}` |
| Create Inbound Trunk | `POST` | `/v3/voice_in_trunks` |
| Update Inbound Trunk | `PATCH` | `/v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}` |
| Delete Inbound Trunk | `DELETE` | `/v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}` |

## Retrieve all Inbound Trunks

Retrieves all Inbound Trunks configured for the account.

Use this endpoint to filter trunks by ID, name, external reference ID, or configuration
type. Results can be sorted by routing, capacity, CLI, timeout, description, and creation
attributes.

See [Retrieve All Inbound Trunks](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/get-voice-in-trunks.html).

```
GET /v3/voice_in_trunks
```

## Retrieve Inbound Trunk

Retrieves a specific Inbound Trunk by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint to inspect the trunk's SIP or PSTN configuration, delivery settings, POP,
and related Inbound Trunk Group.

See [Retrieve Inbound Trunk](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/get-voice-in-trunk.html).

```
GET /v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}
```

## Create Inbound Trunk

Creates a SIP or PSTN Inbound Trunk.

Use a SIP configuration to route calls to a SIP destination, or use a PSTN configuration
to route calls to a phone number. The request can define routing priority and weight,
simultaneous-call limits, ringing timeout, CLI handling, SIP behavior, POP, and related
Inbound Trunk Group.

See [Create Inbound Trunk](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/create-voice-in-trunk.html).

```
POST /v3/voice_in_trunks
```

## Update Inbound Trunk

Updates the settings or configuration of a specific Inbound Trunk.

Use this endpoint to change its destination, routing behavior, simultaneous-call limit,
ringing timeout, CLI handling, description, external reference ID, POP, or Inbound Trunk
Group.

See [Update Inbound Trunk](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/update-voice-in-trunk.html).

```
PATCH /v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}
```

## Delete Inbound Trunk

Deletes a specific Inbound Trunk from the account.

See [Delete Inbound Trunk](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/delete-voice-in-trunk.html).

```
DELETE /v3/voice_in_trunks/{id}
```

## Point of Presence (POP)

The `pop` attribute pins the trunk to a DIDWW Point of Presence. Set it in `attributes`
when creating or updating a trunk. Possible values are `nyc`, `fra`, `lac`, `mia`,
`sg`, `hk`, or `ams`. Set `pop` to `null` to let DIDWW choose. Any other value,
including an uppercase one, returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.

In version `2026-11-19`, `pop` is an attribute of the trunk, not a relationship. The
`/v3/pops` endpoint and `include=pop` are not available and return `400 Bad Request`.

## Configuration reference

Use these pages when configuring or interpreting Inbound Trunk data.

| Reference | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Inbound Trunk Object](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/voice-in-trunk-object.html) | Inbound Trunk attributes, relationships, and SIP or PSTN configuration fields. |
| [Codecs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/codecs.html) | Codec names accepted by the SIP `codecs` setting, their priority order, and the default list. |

## Rerouting Disconnect Codes

Rerouting Disconnect Codes list the supported disconnect-code IDs and SIP response codes
that can be configured on an inbound SIP trunk.

Use the listed IDs in `rerouting_disconnect_code_ids` when creating or updating a SIP
configuration.

See [Rerouting Disconnect Codes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/rerouting-disconnect-codes.html).

## Common Inbound Trunk use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Route calls to a SIP destination | Create a SIP trunk with its Request-URI configuration. |
| Route calls to a PSTN destination | Create a PSTN trunk that forwards incoming calls to a phone number. |
| Configure routing preference | Use priority and weight to control trunk selection and distribute calls. |
| Limit simultaneous calls | Set `capacity_limit` to control the maximum number of concurrent calls delivered to the trunk. |
| Control call setup timeout | Set `ringing_timeout` to stop a delivery attempt when the call is not connected within the configured interval. |
| Configure SIP delivery | Select codecs, DTMF handling, transport, authentication, media behavior, SIP session timers, and other SIP options. |
| Control CLI presentation | Configure the CLI format and optional prefix applied to inbound calls. |
| Configure rerouting behavior | Select the disconnect codes that allow another routing destination to be attempted. |
| Organize routing destinations | Associate trunks with an Inbound Trunk Group and pin them to a DIDWW POP. |

## Related resources

Use Inbound Trunks together with DIDs, trunk groups, and capacity resources to configure
incoming call delivery.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/index.html) | DID phone numbers that can use an Inbound Trunk as their routing destination. |
| [Inbound Trunk Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/index.html) | Groups of Inbound Trunks used for routing and failover. |
| [Capacity Pools](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/capacity-pool/index.html) | Channel capacity available for inbound voice services. |
| [Shared Capacity Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/shared-capacity-group/index.html) | Shared channel allocation for DIDs using inbound voice services. |

item.description:
Use the Inbound Trunk Groups resource to create, retrieve, update, and delete groups of
Inbound Trunks used for incoming call routing.

An Inbound Trunk Group organizes multiple Inbound Trunks into one routing destination that
can be assigned to DID phone numbers. The priority and weight configured on each member
trunk determine how call-delivery attempts are distributed within the group.

Each group has a unique name and can define a simultaneous-call limit and an external
reference ID. Group records also provide their creation time, member-trunk relationship,
and the number of trunks in the group.

## Endpoints

| Action | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieve all Inbound Trunk Groups | `GET` | `/v3/voice_in_trunk_groups` |
| Retrieve Inbound Trunk Group | `GET` | `/v3/voice_in_trunk_groups/{id}` |
| Create Inbound Trunk Group | `POST` | `/v3/voice_in_trunk_groups` |
| Update Inbound Trunk Group | `PATCH` | `/v3/voice_in_trunk_groups/{id}` |
| Delete Inbound Trunk Group | `DELETE` | `/v3/voice_in_trunk_groups/{id}` |

## Retrieve all Inbound Trunk Groups

Retrieves all Inbound Trunk Groups configured for the account.

Use this endpoint to filter groups by external reference ID and sort results by name,
creation time, or simultaneous-call limit. Member Inbound Trunks can be included in the
response.

See [Retrieve All Inbound Trunk Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/get-trunk-groups.html).

```
GET /v3/voice_in_trunk_groups
```

## Retrieve Inbound Trunk Group

Retrieves a specific Inbound Trunk Group by its unique ID.

Use this endpoint to inspect the group settings, member-trunk count, and related Inbound
Trunks.

See [Retrieve Inbound Trunk Group](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/get-trunk-group.html).

```
GET /v3/voice_in_trunk_groups/{id}
```

## Create Inbound Trunk Group

Creates an Inbound Trunk Group.

Provide a unique group name and optionally set an external reference ID, a
simultaneous-call limit, and the Inbound Trunks that should belong to the group.

See [Create Inbound Trunk Group](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/create-trunk-group.html).

```
POST /v3/voice_in_trunk_groups
```

## Update Inbound Trunk Group

Updates a specific Inbound Trunk Group.

Use this endpoint to change the group name, external reference ID, simultaneous-call
limit, or member Inbound Trunks.

See [Update Inbound Trunk Group](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/update-trunk-group.html).

```
PATCH /v3/voice_in_trunk_groups/{id}
```

## Delete Inbound Trunk Group

Deletes a specific Inbound Trunk Group and the trunks in it - a member trunk is not kept as a
standalone trunk. Refused while the group, or any trunk in it, is routed to a DID; route
those DIDs elsewhere first.

See [Delete Inbound Trunk Group](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/delete-trunk-group.html).

```
DELETE /v3/voice_in_trunk_groups/{id}
```

## Data reference

See [Inbound Trunk Group Object](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunk-groups/trunk-group-object.html) for the complete group
attribute, relationship, and metadata definitions.

## Common Inbound Trunk Group use cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Group routing destinations | Organize multiple Inbound Trunks into one destination that can be assigned to DIDs. |
| Configure routing and failover | Combine trunks with different priority and weight values to control call-delivery attempts. |
| Limit simultaneous calls | Set `capacity_limit` to control the maximum number of concurrent calls delivered through the group. |
| Manage group membership | Assign or remove Inbound Trunks when creating or updating the group. |
| Inspect member trunks | Include the `voice_in_trunks` relationship and review the returned `trunks_count` metadata. |
| Synchronize external systems | Store an `external_reference_id` for the corresponding record in another system. |

## Related resources

Use Inbound Trunk Groups together with DIDs, individual trunks, and capacity resources to
configure incoming call delivery.

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Inbound Trunks](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/voice-in-trunks/index.html) | SIP or PSTN routing destinations that can be assigned to a group. |
| [DIDs](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/index.html) | DID phone numbers that can use an Inbound Trunk Group for incoming call routing. |
| [Capacity Pools](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/capacity-pool/index.html) | Channel capacity available for inbound voice services. |
| [Shared Capacity Groups](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/shared-capacity-group/index.html) | Shared channel allocation for DIDs using inbound voice services. |
